sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 original and6x nearest pixels were actually viewed. Single chest-up figure in an olive-grey military jacket with broad notched lapels, gold shoulder braid/epaulettes, pale blue pointed shirt collar and a dark grey-olive tie. Tall plain dark red fez is cut by the top canvas edge; short dark side hair and sideburns remain visible below it, with prominent dark arched brows. No spectacles or facial hair are visible: upper lip, cheeks and chin are smooth. Head is turned slightly toward screen-right, eyes look upward toward screen-right, and the single closed mouth has a restrained neutral expression. Shoulders are cropped at sides and bottom; screen-left face is more brightly lit, screen-right face is shaded. Cream-grey painted background fills the entire rectangle and darkens behind the lower shoulders; no tilted photo frame, separate backing paper, note or handwriting. Actual alpha249..255 is measured, with no exterior cutout in the observed painted canvas. The gold shoulder ornament is visible as a braided form, but its tiny individual markings cannot be securely identified; no exact heraldic detail is asserted under visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 original and6x nearest pixels were actually viewed. Single chest-up figure wearing a fully visible plain dark red fez, short dark hair at the sides, thick dark eyebrows, a full rounded black/dark-brown beard and a dense outward-curving moustache continuous with the beard. No spectacles are visible. Head is almost frontal with a small turn and gaze toward screen-right; single closed mouth is neutral. Olive-grey military coat has broad notched lapels, gold braided shoulder epaulettes, red rectangular collar/lapel patches containing gold vertical motifs, a light grey pointed shirt collar and grey-olive tie. Shoulder sides and lower chest are cropped. Light falls from upper screen-left, shading screen-right cheek/beard; cream-grey painted background fills the entire rectangle and darkens lower down. No separate photograph frame, paper backing, note or handwriting. Actual original alpha250..255 is retained as measured; observed canvas has no exterior cutout. The red patches and gold ornament positions/forms are clearly visible, while exact fine heraldic strokes on them cannot be resolved at source size; no invented exact insignia identity under visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 original and6x nearest pixels were actually viewed. Single chest-up figure with an exceptionally large wrapped blue-grey turban, broad brown crossing bands and thin pale/white stripes; wrapped folds touch/crop at the top and sides. Head is slightly turned toward screen-left and eyes look screen-left, with thick grey-dark brows, a large grey moustache swept outward on both sides and a long full bushy grey beard tapering to a rounded lower point. Scalp hair is hidden by the turban; no spectacles are visible. Single mouth is closed with a stern neutral expression. Very dark navy jacket has broad lapels, one small gold round fitting at each shoulder and a vertical gold leafy motif on each collar/lapel; grey pointed shirt collar and black/dark tie remain visible below the beard. Upper body is cropped at the shoulders and lower chest. Screen-left face and upper turban folds are lit, opposite folds/beard shaded. Continuous cream-grey painted background fills the rectangle; no separate frame, backing paper, note or writing. Actual original alpha249..255 is measured with no observed exterior cutout. Gold motifs are visibly present in those locations but their tiny internal emblems cannot be securely resolved, recorded as an evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Exact156x210 original and6x nearest pixels were actually viewed. Single chest-up figure in a white/light grey peaked naval cap with broad dark band, black visor, gold horizontal braid/cord, gold leaf embroidery on the visor and a centered dark shield-like front panel bearing a gold anchor-and-wreath form. Cap top is cut slightly by the top canvas. Short dark side hair/sideburns, dark brows partly shadowed by the visor, dense dark outward-curving moustache and full rounded dark beard are visible; no spectacles are visible. Near-frontal head turns slightly toward screen-right and eyes look screen-right, with one closed neutral mouth. Dark navy military jacket has broad lapels, red rectangular collar/lapel tabs with gold motifs, gold-striped shoulder epaulettes, a grey-blue pointed shirt collar and dark blue-grey tie. Upper body is cropped at sides and lower chest. Upper screen-left cap/face are brighter, screen-right face and lower uniform shaded. Cream-grey painted backdrop fills the entire rectangle; no photo frame, separate backing, note or handwriting. Measured original alpha249..255 is retained; no exterior cutout is observed. Anchor/wreath, gold leaves and striped shoulder forms are visible, but fine insignia linework cannot be proven stroke-for-stroke at156x210 and remains an explicit evidence limit under visible-source-differences-v1.
